title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: Datadog
providers.scope_notes: IP documentation differs on entitlement (Pro+ via support vs Enterprise). Confirm contract. AWS WIF requires supported integration/configuration.

controls.name: Revoke a token (PAT)
controls.what: Owner or admin revokes a PAT; it stops authenticating within seconds.
controls.setting: Personal Settings > Access Tokens or Organization Settings > Access Tokens > Revoke Token; DELETE /api/v2/personal_access_tokens/<PAT_ID>

controls.name: Disable existing members
controls.what: Disabling a user revokes all of their PATs immediately.

controls.name: User App Keys (user_app_keys) permission
controls.what: Only roles with user_app_keys can create PATs; remove it from a role to stop its members creating PATs.

controls.name: Token scopes
controls.what: Each PAT or SAT must have at least one scope and can only do what its scopes allow.
controls.setting: Select Scopes when creating or editing a token

controls.name: Mandatory PAT time-to-live
controls.what: Every PAT expires between 24 hours and one year after creation; expired tokens are revoked automatically.
controls.setting: Expiration Date at creation (fixed by Datadog bounds)

controls.name: Restrictions on token-authenticated API calls
controls.what: A PAT or SAT cannot create application keys, and can only mint tokens with a subset of its scopes and no longer TTL.

controls.name: IP Allowlist
controls.what: Org-wide allowlist blocks API calls from IPs outside the list, including token-authenticated calls.
controls.setting: Organization Settings > Security > IP Allowlist; IP Allowlist API

no_control.what: IP restriction for a single token; the IP allowlist is org-wide only.

controls_unknown: No org setting found that blocks personal application keys or forces service-account-only keys.

Whether the IP allowlist applies to API-key and client-token requests outside telemetry intake is not stated; entitlement differs between account docs (Pro+/Enterprise) and API reference (Enterprise).
Plan requirement for Agent-based WIF: current WIF page lists no tier; earlier material says Enterprise-only and preview.
How to delete or disable an identity mapping is not documented on the WIF page; intake mappings are deleted via API.
Whether custom roles (needed to narrow these permissions) require a specific plan was not confirmed.

authentication.summary: User-owned bearer token (prefix ddpat_) sent in the Authorization header, or in dd-application-key. No API key needed. Scopes are mandatory.

federation.details: Static bearer token issued by Datadog; no external identity exchange.

ip_restriction.boundary: Org-wide IP allowlist covers all Datadog API calls, so token use from other IPs is blocked; it cannot be set per token. Pro+ or Enterprise, enabled through support.

lifetime.summary: Required TTL, 24 hours to 1 year; fixed at creation

renewal.expiry_basis: Fixed expiration date chosen at creation
renewal.summary: TTL cannot be changed; revoke and create a new token.

administration.summary: Users with user_app_keys create their own PATs under Personal Settings > Access Tokens. Admins with org_app_keys_read/write view and revoke all PATs under Organization Settings > Access Tokens.
administration.conditions: user_app_keys is in the Datadog Standard Role by default.

offboard.details: Disabling a user revokes all of their PATs immediately.

inventory.details: Organization Settings > Access Tokens (org_app_keys_read) or GET /api/v2/personal_access_tokens lists all PATs and SATs.

expiry.ui: Personal Settings > Access Tokens > New token > Expiration Date (24h-1y); admins see expiry in Organization Settings > Access Tokens

offboard.ui: Organization Settings > Users > Edit > Disable toggle > Save

token_format.notes: ddpat_<ALIAS>_<SECRET><CHECKSUM>; alias derived from token UUID, CRC32 checksum, detectable by secret scanners. Token list returns public_portion (prefix + alias).

log_sources.name: Audit Trail
log_sources.notes: Must be enabled (Organization Settings > Audit Trail Settings). Default retention 90 days (3-90 configurable). Records token creation, usage and revocation. Captures authentication method and token metadata per API call.

credential_id_fields.notes: Identifies the token in inventory. Exact Audit Trail attribute name for the token is not documented.
Date the token was last used.

correlation_keys: authentication method facet in Audit Trail
anomaly_cues: GET /api/v2/personal_access_tokens?filter[leaked]=true returns tokens Datadog detected as leaked
New PATs/SATs created by a token-authenticated call (a token can mint subset-scoped tokens)
Recent last_used_at on tokens expected to be idle

containment.steps: Revoke the token in the UI or with DELETE on its endpoint; also list and revoke any tokens it created. For PATs, disabling the owner revokes all their PATs.
containment.notes: Docs: revoked tokens can no longer authenticate; takes effect within seconds (eventual consistency).

unknown: Exact Audit Trail event names and attribute names for PAT/SAT creation, use and revocation

calls.reveals: All users in the org, including deactivated ones
calls.log_notes: Token usage is recorded in Audit Trail generally; no specific event documented for this call.

calls.reveals: All PATs and SATs (names, scopes, expiry, last use) when the token has org_app_keys_read

calls.log_notes: Audit Trail logs Log Management List queries made through the Public API; Audit Trail must be enabled.

unknown: Rate limits for these endpoints with PAT/SAT auth
